nav_description: Manage your profile and account settings
profile_description: Update your name and email address
email_resend: Click here to re-send the verification email.
email_verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
delete_description: Delete your account and all of its resources
delete_warning: Please proceed with caution, this cannot be undone.
delete_confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
delete_confirm_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will also be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.
password_description: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure
appearance_description: Update the appearance settings for your account
two_factor_enabled_text: You will be prompted for a secure, random pin during login, which you can retrieve from the TOTP-supported application on your phone.
two_factor_disabled_text: When you enable two-factor authentication, you will be prompted for a secure pin during login. This pin can be retrieved from a TOTP-supported application on your phone.
recovery_description: Recovery codes let you regain access if you lose your 2FA device. Store them in a secure password manager.
recovery_warning: Each recovery code can be used once to access your account and will be removed after use. If you need more, click {action} above.
setup_enabled_description: Two-factor authentication is now enabled. Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.
setup_verify_description: Enter the {count}-digit code from your authenticator app
setup_enable_description: To finish enabling two-factor authentication, scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app
passkeys_description: Manage your passkeys for passwordless sign-in
passkeys_empty_description: Add a passkey to sign in without a password
passkey_remove_description: Are you sure you want to remove the "{name}" passkey? You will no longer be able to use it to sign in.
passkey_unsupported: Passkeys are not supported in this browser.
passkey_name_help: A name helps you identify this passkey later.
error_setup_key: Failed to fetch a setup key
